cohort: Pregnant women who gave birth in 2019 at Dr. Soetomo General Hospital or Universitas Airlangga Hospital Surabaya.
finding: Robson Group 10 had the highest percentage of Caesarean sections and largest relative contribution at Dr. Soetomo General Hospital, while group 5 had the highest percentage of CS and biggest relative contribution at Universitas Airlangga Hospital.
